content.question: In LIME, how are the most important features for a specific instance identified?
options: By the order in which the features were fed into the network.
Features with the highest coefficients in the fitted linear model are considered the most important.
By counting how often each feature appears in the dataset.
Features whose perturbation never changes the prediction.
content.answer: Features with the highest coefficients in the fitted linear model are considered the most important.
